subject: Operations readiness: RTO/RPO evidence & key-holder declarations
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchestra Bank Security Team <security@orchestrabank.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + key-holder info for vendor review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking our initial phone call yesterday. As part of Orchestra Bank's vendor risk assessment we've been asked to collect a compact evidence packet to substantiate your RTO/RPO commitments and personnel access for critical recovery operations. Could you provide the following by EOD Friday (2025-12-05)?

- A one-page RTO/RPO summary that maps services (API generation, embeddings, internal control plane) to committed RTO/RPO.
- Recent restore/runbook artifacts (last test date and a short narrative for the most recent restore).
- KV/warm-cache snapshot timings (time-to-warm for a typical customer workload; any prefilling strategies).
- Key-holder emergency contact declarations (who has runbook execution authority and phone/email).
- Any recordings or logs from a witness restore (if available) or an attestation we can rely on.

We can treat the packet as draft for now — we just need something our InfoSec team can review before moving to the SIG-QA. If you prefer, we can set a short call to walk through the artifacts.

Appreciate it — happy to be the point of contact on our side.

--
Liam O'Connor
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Orchestra Bank
liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com
+1 415-555-0189

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + key-holder info for vendor review

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a concise packet and aim to deliver the first-pass artifacts by EOD Friday.

Quick notes about scope: our "API generation" surface corresponds to the hosted inference endpoints; RTO is conditioned on the deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated). For the packet we'll provide:

- Single-sheet RTO/RPO mapping (hosted + typical dedicated config).
- Last recovery drill summary (2025-11-01) and the runbook used.
- Warm-cache timing matrix for typical sequence lengths and a 95th percentile warm-up number.
- Signed key-holder declarations (Ops and Platform on-call).
- Link to a short restore run demo recording (if internal policy allows) or a notarized attestation.

Grace and Ben — could you pull the runbook and the KV timings CSV and drop into Jon's shared folder? Marissa — can you prepare the key-holder PDF and sign-off?

If we hit questions from their InfoSec I can join a follow-up call.

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + key-holder info for vendor review

Jonas — pulling artifacts now. Draft items uploaded to: https://drive.redwood/team/practices/ops/recovery-runbooks (shared with liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com). Summary of what's in the folder:

- redwood_rto_rpo_summary_20251130.pdf (RTO/RPO mapping; includes hosted/dedicated notes and fallback behavior)
- runbook-restore-20251101.txt (play-by-play used in last tabletop; includes escalation tree and failover checklist)
- kv-warm-cache-timings-20251125.csv (95th percentile warm times across four example workloads)
- restore-witness-log-20251101.txt (extracted logs from the drill; redacted IPs)
- key-holder-declarations-signed.pdf (signed by Ops Lead and Platform Eng Lead; includes mobile and backup contact)

Notes / callouts: the warm-cache CSV includes a column "time_to_reach_95th_pct" measured from cold start under our standard synthetic workload. For hosted customers we generally reach operational warm cache within 18–26 seconds at p95, while dedicated pools with pre-warming show ~4–8 seconds depending on instance and batch size.

Ben — can you confirm we can share the restore-witness-log text? I redacted PII but left traces of timestamps for reproducibility.

Thanks — Grace

On Wed, Dec 3, 2025 at 10:03 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a concise packet and aim to deliver the first-pass artifacts by EOD Friday.
>

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 16:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + key-holder info for vendor review

Grace / team — reviewed the restore-witness-log; safe to share w/ external after redaction (no keys, no user data). Uploaded the redacted file and confirmed checksums in the folder. Also attached a short narrative (two paragraphs) describing the drill objectives, measured RTO, and the mitigation steps we validated.

Attachment stubs: restore-witness-log-20251101-redacted.txt (text), restore-drill-summary-20251101.pdf (2pp).

Marissa — can you route the key-holder declarations to Legal for the standard external redaction clause? Once Legal gives the greenlight we'll send the signed PDF to Liam.

Thanks — Ben

On Thu, Dec 4, 2025 at 2:28 PM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jonas — pulling artifacts now. Draft items uploaded to: https://drive.redwood/team/practices/ops/recovery-runbooks (shared with liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com).

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchestra Bank Security Team <security@orchestrabank.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 08:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + key-holder info for vendor review

Thanks for the fast turnaround, Jonas / team — I reviewed the folder and the artifacts look good. Two quick clarification items before we proceed to the SIG-QA intake: 

1) In the RTO/RPO summary the hosted endpoint lists "best-effort 5 min" for control-plane failover. Can you confirm whether that is measured from incident detection or from failover initiation? (Our policy counts from incident detection.)

2) For the key-holder declarations we need an explicit emergency phone that is monitored 24x7 (not just an email). The PDF you uploaded lists mobile numbers but not an explicit on-call escalation phone. Would you be able to add that?

If you can answer both by EOD we can include the packet as evidence in the SIG intake. If it's easier to hop on a 20-minute call I can do 10:30am PT today.

Cheers —
Liam

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + key-holder info for vendor review

Liam — good catch. Short answers:

1) The "best-effort 5 min" metric in that table is measured from incident detection (we trigger failover automation as part of our monitoring pipeline). We updated the one-pager to explicitly state "measured from detection (monitoring alert)".

2) We've added a monitored emergency line (Ops Escalation Desk) in the key-holder declarations PDF that is staffed 24x7 and routes to the on-call engineer tier (phone: +1-888-700-2501). The updated file is: key-holder-declarations-signed.pdf (v2).

I've pushed both updates to the Drive folder and re-shared the link. For the SIG intake you should be set — happy to join the 10:30am PT call if you'd like to walk through specifics.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orchestrabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchestra Bank Security Team <security@orchestrabank.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + key-holder info for vendor review

Perfect — that's everything we needed for the SIG-QA intake. We'll proceed and loop back if anything comes up. Appreciate the rapid support.

I'll drop a calendar invite for a quick hygiene call next week (optional) in case the security team wants a short walk-through.

Regards,
Liam
